title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mystic Lake Casino Hotel, Prior Lake | 2023
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mystic Lake Casino Hotel in Prior Lake, Minnesota, USA, on 1 October 2023.

It was the 35th show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 43 dates between May and October 2023.

Starr had previously performed at the Mystic Lake Casino Hotel on 14 July 2008, 25 July 2010, and 22 August 2019.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
